nodes.label: SVGF
nodes.rationale: Denoising is a modified SVGF loop (temporal plus a-trous) that upsamples additively into LBuffer.

nodes.label: velocity
nodes.rationale: Motion uses Anomaly's render-resolution RG16F velocity (previousPixel = currentPixel + motion). Depth compares catalog linearDepth, not hardware depth.

nodes.label: Anomaly Owns Shared Gaps
nodes.rationale: When this pack invents lighting, IsolatedMix energy, or march LOD that the next Anomaly shader will also need, file it on Anomaly rather than leaving it pack-private.

nodes.label: Rich HUD Deferred Config Save
nodes.rationale: Rich HUD sliders must not serialize or write config on every tick.

nodes.label: Anomaly Shader Pack
nodes.rationale: This plugin is an Anomaly shader pack. It does not replace Keen's shader compiler or own GBuffer Target3.

nodes.label: Deferred Config Flush
nodes.rationale: Rich HUD setters mark dirty; flush from Plugin.Update after ~400 ms. The MyGui dialog saves on Save.

nodes.label: Quality Presets
nodes.rationale: This is a heavy pass. Slices, steps, and resolution scale dominate. Low traces at quarter-res (4 steps, 2 a-trous); Medium/High use half-res.
